Twelve comments

This was the 3rd tune I learnt as a beginner, and is the 3rd in the trilogy of polka tunes frequently played for set dancing at an Irish club in Bristol (UK), the other tunes being Terry Teahan’s and Henry’s Polka, both on The Session database.

trevor

Re: Riding On A Load Of Hay

Some info on the tune (from http://slowplayers.org/2014/05/05/riding-on-a-load-of-hay-eaeol/ ):
“Riding on a Load of Hay” is a West Kerry polka, and was in the repertoire of Kerry fiddler Denis Murphy (1910-1974). It is [likely] a polka adaptation of the Scottish strathspey “Miss Ramsay of Barnton” (c. 1884).
